propositions: Compaction writes SNAPSHOT.json and renames sources to *.retired non-atomically without rollback; if the detached sweep is killed before commit, the working tree is left dirty with untracked files.

Union merge in _union_merge runs git merge origin/tickets; when a peer has pushed the same *.retired/SNAPSHOT paths, the merge must CREATE those paths but they exist untracked in the working tree, causing git to abort with 'untracked working tree files would be overwritten by merge'.

The abort handler is abort-only and push-recovery cannot clear untracked files (git reset --hard is tracked-only, _stash_create omits -u flag), so every retry re-aborts identically and wedges the store permanently.
Local ticket events and commits remain stranded off origin because the reconverge cannot complete; if the worktree is removed, the commits are lost.

The fix quarantines only the exact untracked paths that git names in the error, relocates them outside the worktree to <git-common-dir>/reconverge-quarantine/<utc-ts>/, and retries the merge once; on success both parents are kept and no local commit is orphaned.
